scope:
Attribute a newly opened vault's capital to authenticated funding origins.

Requires bounded bridge/cash routes. Same-transaction draws are accepted only
when the bridge claim is the sole destination and transaction value conserves.
An optional scoped origin ledger follows related upstream holdings. Otherwise
source capital remains unresolved. Withdrawals release each origin's
weighted-average cost; reinvesting the resulting gains never creates debt.
This diagnostic does not assign later ilk repayments or calculate financing.

upstream_origin_group.scope:
Original borrowing attribution within explicitly selected allocation accounts.

No unrelated repayments refinance these accounts. Internal transfers carry a
weighted-average origin mix; gifts and mark growth never create borrowed basis.
For mixed transactions, other destinations and unaccounted execution losses
consume the draw first. The remainder is a conservative draw contribution.
Results are conditional on normalized movements and this attribution convention.

upstream_reallocation.policy: Weighted-average acquisition cost; proportional cost/gain split of a single receipt. Original borrowing is recognized only when supported by an explicit scoped origin trace.
